c1-32-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Annul a Rule?
c1-32-01.scenario: A friend who is reading about the Constitutional Court asks why a rule can be annulled and what prior review means.
c1-32-01.prompt: Tell your friend why the body annulled the provision, and when prior review takes place.
cues: Give the reason for annulling the provision
Say when prior review examines a law
c1-32-01.target: A testület jogbiztonsági okból megsemmisítette a rendelkezést. Az előzetes normakontroll a kihirdetés előtt vizsgálja a jogszabályt.
c1-32-01.english: For reasons of legal certainty the body annulled the provision. Prior review examines a law before it is promulgated.
c1-32-01.canDo: I can give the reason for a decision with *jogbiztonsági okból* or *alkotmányossági szempontból*.

c1-32-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Limiting a Right
c1-32-02.scenario: A friend asks you what a law that limits a right must be like, and what happens to a limitation that harms the essential content.
c1-32-02.prompt: Tell your friend what a law that limits a right must be, and what a limitation that harms the essential content is.
cues: Say what a law that limits a right must be
Say what a limitation that harms the essential content is
c1-32-02.target: A jogot korlátozó törvénynek arányosnak kell lennie. A lényeges tartalmat sértő korlátozás alaptörvény-ellenes.
c1-32-02.english: A law that limits a right must be proportionate. A limitation that harms the essential content is unconstitutional.
c1-32-02.canDo: I can describe a rule with a participle before the noun, as in *a jogot korlátozó törvény*.

c1-32-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Dignity Matters
c1-32-03.scenario: A friend has read about Sólyom László and asks why human dignity is so important in law.
c1-32-03.prompt: Tell your friend why the protection of human dignity is important, and what guides the judge.
cues: Give a moral reason for protecting dignity
Say what guides the judge's decision
c1-32-03.target: Erkölcsi okból is fontos az emberi méltóság védelme. A méltóság tiszteletétől vezérelve döntött így a bíró.
c1-32-03.english: For moral reasons too the protection of human dignity is important. Guided by respect for dignity, the judge decided so.
c1-32-03.canDo: I can give a moral reason with *erkölcsi okból* or *erkölcsi szempontból*.

c1-32-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Cause of a Decision
c1-32-04.scenario: A friend asks you why a court declared a provision void and what a dissenting opinion is.
c1-32-04.prompt: Tell your friend why the provision is void and what a dissenting opinion means.
cues: Give the cause why the provision is void
Say what a dissenting opinion is
c1-32-04.target: A rendelkezés visszaható hatálya miatt semmis. A különvélemény azt jelenti, hogy egy bíró nem ért egyet a döntéssel.
c1-32-04.english: The provision is void because of its retroactive effect. A dissenting opinion means that a judge does not agree with the decision.
c1-32-04.canDo: I can give the cause of a decision with *miatt* or *következtében*.

c1-32-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Judge and the Principles
c1-32-05.scenario: A friend has read about Sólyom László and asks what the idea of the invisible constitution means.
c1-32-05.prompt: Tell your friend what the invisible constitution is, and what a judge would have done without a written rule.
cues: Say what the invisible constitution is
Say what a judge would have done without a written rule
c1-32-05.target: A láthatatlan alkotmány az írott szövegen túli alapelvek rendszere. Ha nem lett volna írott szabály, a bíró az alapelvekből indult volna ki.
c1-32-05.english: The invisible constitution is the system of principles beyond the written text. If there had been no written rule, the judge would have started from the principles.
c1-32-05.canDo: I can say what a judge would have done with *ha … volna, … volna*.

c1-32-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Summing Up the Unit
c1-32-consolidation.scenario: At the end of a talk about the Constitutional Court, a friend asks you what you learned.
c1-32-consolidation.prompt: Tell your friend why a rule can be annulled, what a law that limits a right must be, and what a judge would have done without a written rule.
cues: Give a reason for annulling a rule
Say what a law that limits a right must be
Say what a judge would have done without a written rule
c1-32-consolidation.target: A testület jogbiztonsági okból megsemmisítette a rendelkezést. A jogot korlátozó törvénynek arányosnak kell lennie. Ha nem lett volna írott szabály, a bíró az alapelvekből indult volna ki.
c1-32-consolidation.english: For reasons of legal certainty the body annulled the provision. A law that limits a right must be proportionate. If there had been no written rule, the judge would have started from the principles.
c1-32-consolidation.canDo: I can use the words of constitutional review, fundamental rights and judicial reasoning.
